results.title: Smartwatches may overestimate calories burned during exercise
results.description: Smartwatches can significantly overestimate how many calories people burn during exercise, and their calorie estimates become less accurate as body fat increases, according to a new Florida International University study.

results.title: Which auto stocks should you buy after August sales? Here's what Jefferies, Nomura, Citi say
results.description: Compared with Jefferies' estimates, August wholesales were broadly in line for Maruti Suzuki, Hero MotoCorp and Hyundai, while the rest of the automakers came in ahead of expectations.

results.title: Research: Nordics spend €280m a year on pirate streaming
results.description: In spring 2026, almost one in ten households across Denmark, Finland, Norway and Sweden had access to illegal IPTV. These households report paying an average of approximately €20 per month, according to research from Mediavision.
